stories.title: Police warn riders over missing number plates after north Flintshire seizure
stories.summary: A scooter has been seized by North Wales Police officers covering north Flintshire, who used the case to warn riders about hiding or removing registration plates. stories.title: Chester Zoo cuts afternoon entry to £10 until 6 September

stories.title: Developer seeks costs from Flintshire council over refused Ewloe housing scheme
stories.summary: A developer is asking for Flintshire County Council to pay its costs after councillors refused 315 homes in Ewloe against the advice of their own planning officers.
